name: Mount Gower
reason: Four counted sources; the island's signature guided day walk to the 875 m summit, a real half-day-plus activity.

name: Mount Lidgbird
reason: No counted source; Wikipedia only, not promoted by the island walking list or Wikivoyage, and not a visitor climb.

name: Ball's Pyramid
reason: Three counted sources; visitors can take a boat tour around it and dive it, so there is something to do though no landing. Obvious draw.

name: Ned's Beach
reason: Four counted sources; hand-feeding fish and snorkelling is the island's signature beach activity.

name: Blinky Beach
reason: Three counted sources; surf and swim beach, second-tier beach a tourism board names.

name: Old Settlement Beach
reason: Four counted sources; swimming, turtles and sandstone rocks, plus the walk start.

name: North Bay
reason: Three counted sources; north-coast bay with picnic facilities and snorkelling, reached on foot or by water.

name: Middle Beach
reason: Two counted sources; central lagoon beach by the township, swimming stop. Pin approximate/disambiguation noted.

name: Lagoon Beach
reason: For: two counted sources, a swim and stroll beach. Against: lagoon shore stretch overlapping Middle Beach and the lagoon generally; near-duplicate feel.

name: Boat Harbour
reason: For: two counted sources, sheltered cove. Against: reached only along the coastal track, effectively an end point of a walk and not distinct.

name: Muttonbird Point
reason: For: two counted sources, seabird-colony view. Against: lookout on the coastal track, a short stop that is part of a larger walk.

name: Malabar Hill
reason: Four counted sources; the island's most popular walk with cliff views and tropicbirds.

name: Pooles Lookout
reason: Minor lookout that is part of the Malabar Hill walk, already listed.

name: Kim's Lookout
reason: Three counted sources, but a viewpoint on the Malabar ridge walk and part of the larger Malabar Hill spot.

name: Mount Eliza
reason: For: two counted sources, a short summit walk. Against: closed to the public September to March for nesting terns, and part of the North Bay area.

name: Intermediate Hill
reason: Three counted sources; summit with viewing platform and views to Ball's Pyramid, a named walk stop.

name: Transit Hill
reason: Three counted sources; easy walk to a 360-degree lookout platform.

name: Goat House Cave
reason: For: two counted sources. Against: a hard rope-assisted walk to a small cave, not a cave visit; niche.

name: The Clear Place
reason: For: two counted sources, an easy named forest walk. Against: a 1.2 km return stroll to a clearing; marginal draw.

name: Valley of the Shadows
reason: A short side diversion of the Clear Place walk; part of a larger spot.

name: Stevens Reserve
reason: For: two counted sources, signed forest loop walk. Against: short ordinary loop by the boat sheds; marginal.

name: Old Gulch
reason: Small cove on a 0.3 km boardwalk from North Bay; part of the North Bay area, a minor stop.

name: Max Nichols Memorial Track
reason: For: two counted sources, a named ridge walk linking two beaches. Against: short connector track, mostly a way between two listed beaches.

name: Little Island
reason: For: two counted sources, easy 3 km walk to a lagoon clearing. Against: long walk to an unremarkable clearing; marginal.

name: Lord Howe Island Museum
reason: Two counted sources; open daily, history and world-heritage exhibits with visitor centre.

name: Catalina Wreckage
reason: For: Wikivoyage names the flying-boat wreck and a monument stands there. Against: one counted source, small wreck remains beside Old Settlement Beach.

name: Lord Howe Island Botanic Gardens
reason: For: Wikivoyage lists it, public garden. Against: one counted source, small garden; Wikivoyage notes the whole island is effectively a garden.

name: Lord Howe Island Permanent Park Preserve
reason: A protected area covering two thirds of the island, not a single place a visitor goes to; the walks within are the spots.

name: Lord Howe Island Marine Park
reason: A managed zone, not one place; the snorkel and dive sites within it are the spots.

name: Erscott's Hole
reason: Two counted sources; the island's best accessible snorkelling reef.

name: Comet's Hole
reason: For: Wikivoyage's best Galapagos shark spot, snorkel/dive. Against: one counted source, a dive site offshore for experienced swimmers.

name: Admiralty Islands
reason: For: Wikivoyage lists boat and dive visits. Against: one counted source, reached only by operator boat tour or dive trip, no landing.

name: Blackburn Island
reason: No counted source; Wikipedia geography category only, no visitor access.

name: Wolf Rock
reason: No counted source; offshore rock named only in Wikipedia geography.

name: Erskine Valley
reason: No counted source; Wikipedia geography category only, no visitor draw.

name: Lord Howe Island Weather Station
reason: Working facility; public access unconfirmed and the balloon launch is a twice-daily event, not a place to visit.
